goal: Fix batch_preflight.ts so a settled (non-active) batch record never causes a fresh batch to inherit a stale budget or be reconstructed as already-settled: is_resuming must be computed once from activeRecord !== null and used identically for both the budget-inheritance decision and the reported projection field.

acceptance.assertion: A new fixture in tests/unattended-batch-run.test.ts drives a settled BatchRunStateRecord (batch_state not 'running') with an expired authorization_expires_at and budget.deadline_at, then calls the preflight path the Host adapters use for a fresh batch on that initiative_slug. The returned projection issues a fresh default budget (max_children: 10, deadline_at approximately DEFAULT_BATCH_BUDGET_MS out from now, qa_failure_limit: 2), not the settled record's stale budget, and at least one child is not force-reconstructed as already_settled.

projectPlanSurface and projectBatchDrift in plugins/immune-brain/runtime/unattended/batch_preflight.ts derive is_resuming from the same activeRecord !== null value everywhere it is read within one call; no code path can pass a different is_resuming into projectPlanSurface than the is_resuming reported back in the returned projection for the same on-disk state.
